description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把搅拌泵一体机列在 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Integrated Mixer Pump; 主电机 / 搅拌电机 45 kW / 14 kW; 理论输送量 21 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m; 最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below; 输送管内径 100 / 125 mm; 外形尺寸 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 4500 kg; 系列说明 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mi

h1.en: Power and particle size for the Integrated Mixer Pump stay on the printed row
h1.zh: 搅拌泵一体机的动力和粒径以已印行为准

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Integrated Mixer Pump at /products/integrated-mixer-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Integrated Mixer Pump; Main Motor / Mixer Motor 45 kW / 14 kW; Theoretical Output 21 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below; Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Main Unit Weight 4500 kg; Series Note 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and Main Unit Weight is 4500 kg. The printed output cell is 21 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 4 cm and below. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/integrated-mixer-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foundation_(engineering). It shows: Drawing of Poteaux-en-Terre post in ground type of wall construction (this example technically called pallisade construction) in the Beauvais House in Ste Genevieve, Missouri. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把搅拌泵一体机列在 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Integrated Mixer Pump; 主电机 / 搅拌电机 45 kW / 14 kW; 理论输送量 21 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m; 最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below; 输送管内径 100 / 125 mm; 外形尺寸 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 4500 kg; 系列说明 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer。运输请抄外形尺寸是 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm，整机重量是 4500 kg。已印输送量是 21 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。已印骨料或粒径是 4 cm and below。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/integrated-mixer-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foundation_(engineering) 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：木柱埋地墙的画法图。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/integrated-mixer-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model Integrated Mixer Pump; Main Motor / Mixer Motor 45 kW / 14 kW; Theoretical Output 21 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below; Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Main Unit Weight 4500 kg; Series Note 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Integrated Mixer Pump; 主电机 / 搅拌电机 45 kW / 14 kW; 理论输送量 21 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m; 最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below; 输送管内径 100 / 125 mm; 外形尺寸 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 4500 kg; 系列说明 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 21 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 4 cm and below. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 21 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。已印骨料或粒径是 4 cm and below。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/integrated-mixer-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/integrated-mixer-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Is a price printed for the Integrated Mixer Pump?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机印了价格吗？

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Can OEM numbers be guessed from a similar machine?
question.zh: OEM 数字能按相似机器猜吗？

answer.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/integrated-mixer-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print.
answer.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/integrated-mixer-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。
